ana: FYI - field team for HelixHealth hit a blocker during on-prem install. Critical inference nodes are crashing after our marketplace image boots; suspect NIC driver/firmware mismatch.
li: on it. Which image & node model?
sam: tagging eng-runtime and eng-infra. @miguel please triage driver compat. Can we get a safe fallback to CPU-only for critical customer?
miguel: I can try a quick build of a cpu-fallback image and a runtime flag to force device mask. Will need a few hours. Meanwhile, can field attach kernel logs + dmesg.
ana: (typo) ignore — continuing.
li: already collected logs, uploading to S3: https://s3.redwood/internal/helix-dmesg-2239999999.log 
li: log snippet: ```kernel: rcu_sched self-detected stall on CPU(s) ... mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: firmware failed (-110)```
harper: customer is in go-live tomorrow EOD; they need either a mitigation or scheduled downtime. What's fastest? :eyes:  
deploy-bot: marketplace image redwood-inference/runner:v2.3.5 flagged for recall on marketplace. Reason: node crash reports from partner field. (automated)
sam: ok, proposed plan: 1) temporary: deploy CPU-only canary to 10% of pods for this customer, 2) eng-runtime investigates kernel oops and driver fallback, 3) field to apply NIC firmware if vendor has patch. @miguel ETA on a cpu-only canary image?
miguel: ETA ~3h for PR and canary image. If vendor firmware exists that's preferable. Need runbook steps for field to apply firmware safely.
li: vendor support responded — firmware 2.1.7 includes mlx5 fix but requires maintenance reboot. Tech note attached in S3.
ana: (again) good catch.
sam: can we keep service up with CPU fallback until firmware window? If yes we'll avoid a daytime outage.
miguel: yes — runtime can boot without NIC devices by masking them; adding `--device-mask` flag and a cpu-only image tag v2.3.5-cpu. Pushing PR now: https://github.com/redwood/eng-runtime/pull/4821 
harper: I can schedule route change to the cpu-fallback pool and notify the customer. Will also prepare rollback notes and update the SI runbook under 'marketplace image incident'.
li: canary ran on 3 test nodes earlier — no crashes, perf ~0.9x of GPU baseline. Starting customer canary in 10m.
ana: thanks all. After PR merges + canary success, we should 1) mark v2.3.5 recalled, 2) coordinate partner comms re: firmware window, 3) post-mortem and runbook updates. I'll draft the post-mortem template and share.
harper: customer call scheduled +30m. Putting a short status update in #partnerships-updates and tagging partner field lead.
li: field report after customer canary: no crashes after 45m. Vendor will schedule firmware 2.1.7 for midnight local, customer agreed.
sam: great — leaving this open until firmware applied and we validate. Closing checklist: PR merged? yes. Marketplace recall in place? yes. Customer notified? yes.
ana: I'll follow up with joint announcement draft for partner comms and ops notes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
